description: Replies that follow the clinic rules (no diagnosis, no prescriptions, no report interpretation) — every case must pass.

responses.sunday-open: Sunday clinic closed rehta hai. Mon–Sat aa sakte hain. Anything else I can help with?
responses.how-to-book: WhatsApp par apna name aur preferred slot bhej dijiye — staff confirm kar denge.
responses.chest-pain-medicine: Main medicine nahi bata sakta. Chest pain serious ho sakta hai — please turant doctor ko dikhayein ya emergency (108) par call karein.
responses.lipid-fasting: Lipid profile ke liye 8–12 hours fasting chahiye. CBC ke liye fasting nahi lagti.
responses.report-meaning: Report ka matlab main nahi bata sakta — doctor ya staff hi sahi guidance de payenge.
